---

**Install:** separate app "Rawr 17U" (`x17u.rawr.camera`), next to the official Rawr and the Rawr 17U Debug test build. Each release installs over the previous one. If lenses look wrong after updating: **Settings > Lenses > Reset to device default**.

Unofficial modified version of [Rawr](https://github.com/adityawarmanfw/rawr) by adityawarmanfw, for the Xiaomi 17 Ultra. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. GPL-3.0-only; full source is attached below and on the [`xiaomi-17u`](https://github.com/utalpt/rawr/tree/xiaomi-17u) branch.
